purpose: Teach: 目印/織物/運気/箇条/羅列/撫で/止む/アコースティック

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、待ち合わせの、本気で、絶対、目印、絶対、駅前の時計台、絶対、にしようね
lines.en: Riku, let's definitely make the station clock tower our meeting spot, okay?
lines.style: Bright, direct, with a note of playful insistence. Quick energy. She's serious about this plan but keeps it light — the tone of someone who's thought this through and wants his agreement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。家庭科で、本気で、絶対、織物、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. We actually learned weaving in home ec, didn't we, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle, almost nostalgic. A small smile in the voice. He's making a genuine connection between what she said and his own memory — not defensive, just reflecting. Soft and assured.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、運気、絶対、上がりますように、絶対、お参り、絶対、しようよ、リク
lines.en: Let's go pray at the shrine before the test, Riku. For good luck.
lines.style: Earnest and hopeful, building slightly toward the end. She means this. Not urgent or demanding, but genuine — the voice of someone who believes in small rituals and wants him to believe too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験の準備、本気で、絶対、箇条書きに、絶対、まとめたぜ、桜
lines.en: I actually organized all my test prep into bullet points, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. He's not boasting, just stating a fact he's genuinely satisfied with. Steady, grounded tone. The satisfaction of preparation done well.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 重要ポイント、本気で、絶対、羅列、絶対、ノートに、絶対、まとめたよ、リク
lines.en: I compiled all the important points into notes, Riku.
lines.style: Animated and direct, with a hint of satisfaction. She's showing him she's prepared too. Bright energy, matching his effort with her own. A little lifted at the end, like she's presenting something she's done.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、猫を、絶対、撫でて、絶対、癒されたぜ、桜
lines.en: I went to my grandmother's place and petted her cat — it really helped calm me down, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, almost vulnerable. A small, genuine smile in the voice. He's admitting something tender — that he needed comfort and found it. Slow, unhurried pace. Sincere without performing sincerity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 雨が、本気で、絶対、止む、絶対、まで、絶対、コンビニで、絶対、待ったよ、リク
lines.en: I waited for you at the convenience store until the rain stopped, Riku.
lines.style: Calm and matter-of-fact, but with an underlying gentleness. She's stating something patient and kind she did without making a show of it. Steady tone, slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、本気で、絶対、アコースティック、絶対、ライブ、絶対、やるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: We're doing an acoustic live at the cultural festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Excited and committed, building energy toward the end. He's announcing something important to him. Open, animated delivery. The voice of someone about to do something that matters.
